checks.acceptance: Preview, local playback and saved bytes reflect the same selected effect; choice/state remains visible.
checks.stimulus: Toggle blur on the ready screen and record a local sample.

checks.acceptance: No unblurred frame is silently stored; participant gets a safe technical/alternate-mode path.
checks.stimulus: Force segmenter failure and CPU overload while recording.

checks.acceptance: Report frame loss, leakage, usability and differential failure with registered limits before enabling blur.
checks.stimulus: Measure diverse devices, lighting, hair/skin/assistive items and audio continuity.

claim_ceiling: Candidate design record only; no executed check, selected integration, participant-data permission or release.
environment: synthetic patterned room, different lighting/appearance and browser/device matrix
evidence_requirements: attributed pass, fail or inconclusive result for every check
logs or receipts sufficient for independent replay
recorded deviations, adverse effects and unresolved uncertainty
failure_route: Disable blur mode on failing devices and offer non-punitive alternate/retry path; no covert raw fallback.
objective: Prove optional blur is visible, recorded, private and usable on supported devices.
rejection_gates: any silent data loss or untraceable score-path change
unresolved differential failure or unsupported mode presented as valid
threshold_registration: Quantitative limits, supported devices, cost ceiling and reviewer acceptance authority must be fixed before a run can support pilot selection.
